svg.title: Dhaulagiri — mountain relief
svg.desc: Northeastern massif, aerial perspective. High snow dome, steep rock ribs, northeastern ridge and hanging icefields. Layered vector contour adaptation of a photograph by Sergey Ashmarin. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Dhaulagiri_-_view_from_aircraft.jpg. License: CC BY-SA 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Changes: sky removed, cropped, tonal contours traced, blue and white palette.
